field.label: Enable Extension
field.comment: Disabling this will completely disable the extension and will not allow the Chatbot/Assistant to appear on the storefront.

field.label: Show Chatbot on Storefront
field.comment: Disables the Chatbot appearance on the storefront while backend features and synchronization remain active.

field.label: ChatBot Public UUID
field.comment: Provide the ChatBot Public UUID from your Clusterify Dashboard > Chatbot page.

field.label: Automatic Storefront Embed Code (Information / Preview Only)

group.label: ChatBot Visibility Per Page Type
group.comment:
Control which storefront page types the ChatBot & Assistant widget is permitted to appear on. By default, Cart and Checkout pages are disabled while other pages are enabled.

These page types are dynamically discovered from your Magento environment and installed extensions. The assistant is engineered to operate seamlessly without disrupting page layouts or functionality; however, you have complete freedom to disable any page type you prefer. We recommend previewing your storefront on pages where you have custom layouts or interactive workflows.

field.label: API Public Key
field.comment: Enter your Clusterify Public Key (pk_live_...) from Dashboard > API Keys.

field.label: API Secret Key
field.comment: Enter your Clusterify Secret Key (sk_live_...) from Dashboard > API Keys.

field.label: API Base URL
field.comment: Default: https://api.clusterify.ai. Override only for testing/staging environments.

group.label: URL Knowledge Base Synchronization
group.comment: Configure automatic background synchronization of storefront pages to Clusterify.AI's deep URL-Based Assistant Knowledge Base using RabbitMQ.

field.label: Enable Knowledge Base Sync
field.comment: Master switch for URL Knowledge Base background synchronization. When disabled, indexers and queue consumers pause sync dispatches.

field.label: Synchronize CMS Pages
field.comment: Automatically pushes content from active CMS pages (Policies, About Us, Customer Service, etc.) to Clusterify AI.

field.label: Synchronize Category Pages
field.comment: Automatically pushes category descriptions and subcategory navigation hierarchies to Clusterify AI.

field.label: Synchronize Product Pages
field.comment: Automatically pushes product descriptions, SKUs, pricing, and stock status for individually visible products to Clusterify AI.

field.label: Sync Custom AI Knowledge (Instead of Core Descriptions)
field.comment:
Choose whether to synchronize dedicated AI training context or standard storefront descriptions to the Clusterify Knowledge Base.

• Yes (Recommended / Default): Synchronizes URL, Title/Name, SKU, Price/Availability (if enabled below), and the dedicated ChatBot Knowledge & AI Context attribute instead of standard storefront HTML descriptions. If custom knowledge is empty for an entity, it safely falls back to standard descriptions.
• No: Synchronizes URL, Title/Name, SKU, Price/Availability (if enabled below), and standard storefront HTML descriptions (Summary and Description).

⚠️ Operational Notice: Changing this setting requires running a full reindex across your indexers (bin/magento indexer:reindex clusterify_chatbot_cms clusterify_chatbot_category clusterify_chatbot_product) and processing queue tasks to update existing Knowledge Base entries with the new content format. This is an asynchronous background process, and the chatbot's knowledge will update progressively as the queue tasks complete.

field.label: Sync Product Price to ChatBot
field.comment: When enabled, formatted product prices are synchronized into the ChatBot Knowledge Base. When set to No (default), product prices are omitted from the AI context so visitors check live pricing directly on the page.

field.label: Sync Product Availability (Stock Status) to ChatBot
field.comment: When enabled, product stock availability (In Stock / Out of Stock) is synchronized into the ChatBot Knowledge Base. When set to No (default), availability status is omitted from the AI context.

field.label: Sync In-Stock Products Only
field.comment:
When enabled, out-of-stock products are automatically excluded and purged from the Clusterify Knowledge Base to conserve URL quotas.

⚠️ Operational Notice: Changing this setting requires running a product reindex (bin/magento indexer:reindex clusterify_chatbot_product) and processing the queue to discover and remove previously synchronized out-of-stock items. This is an asynchronous background process, and the chatbot's catalog knowledge will update progressively as the queue tasks complete. Consider whether your shoppers benefit from the chatbot answering questions about temporarily out-of-stock items before enabling.

field.label: Automated Background Queue Processing (Cron)
field.comment: When enabled, Magento cron automatically drains pending RabbitMQ tasks every minute, ensuring synchronization progresses without manual CLI commands or persistent server daemons.

field.label: Queue Batch Size Per Run
field.comment: Maximum number of pending messages processed per entity queue during each background cron or on-demand execution (default: 50).
